newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Standard plans US$40 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Asia Standard plans US$40 mln bond issue.

text.p: Property and investment concern Asia Standard International Group Ltd said on Thursday its wholly-owned Asia Standard International Capital Ltd proposed to launch a five-year US$40 million convertible bond issue.
Asia Standard said an option would be granted to the manager of the issue requiring the company to issue a further amount up to US$15 million, it said in a statement.

The detailed pricing and other terms of the bonds, including the interest rate, conversion premium and timing of the bonds, have not yet been determined and will be finalised in due course, the company said.
An application has been made to list the bonds in Luxembourg, it added.
The company's chairman Clement Fung said proceeds raised from the issue will used for property development, land acquisitions and for general working capital.
The capital value of all the group's properties was valued at HK$8.84 billion as at June 30, 1996, the company said.
